title: Lesson 1 — Vocabulary Exhibition (Prototype)
notes: Intro: 3s black → 2s artwork fade-in (gallery style); no opening crest. Outro: gold gallery crest hold, fades with soundtrack end. Rebuild each verse from vocabulary and phrases; same gallery atmosphere. ~15 steps per exhibit. Soundtrack 1:01:56; crest exhale syncs to bed end.

verse.jpHtml:
木きの床ゆかに　一ひとつの柿かきが光ひかり
障子しょうじの午後ごごが　静しずけさを包つつむ
verse.en:
A single persimmon glowed upon the wooden floor,
while afternoon light through the shoji held the room in stillness.
